thread:
mike.finance: FYI — CloudRack posted a reversal on vendor credit CR-2024-998 for $18,450 that we processed last month. It originally reduced deferred revenue tied to prepaid commits. The reversal landed this period as an AP/Cash adjustment. Need guidance for month-end rev-rec treatment.

jordan.accounting: Please paste the ERP lines so we can trace flow. Did we ever recognize any of that reduced balance as revenue?

mike.finance: Copy from ERP:```
2025-02-12  GL2100 Deferred Revenue  CR 18,450  (credit memo applied)
           GL2000 Cash/Bank        DR 18,450
2025-03-20  GL2000 Cash/Bank        CR 18,450  (reversal)
           GL2010 AP - CloudRack   DR 18,450```
No issuance of revenue against this amount — it lowered the deferred liability only.

olivia.revrec: If the original entry reduced deferred revenue, then the reversal should reinstate deferred revenue (i.e., increase the liability). That avoids P&L hit assuming we didn't recognize any portion.

sara.billing: Confirmed — the customer prepay pool decreased by the credit. No consumption mapping to that credit.

jordan.accounting: Proposed correcting journal for the close:```
2025-03-31  DR 2010 AP - CloudRack     18,450
            CR 2100 Deferred Revenue  18,450```
This nets out the AP/Cash impact and restores the deferred liability so revenue isn't affected.

mike.finance: Sounds good. Two operational asks: 1) I'll include CloudRack's support thread as backup, and 2) if CloudRack later confirms the reversal was erroneous, we'll need a second adjusting entry — track separately.

anna.cfo: Make sure we tag this as "prior-period obligation reinstatement" in the close pack and include sign-off from RevRec. If audit asks, we need the vendor confirmation chain.

olivia.revrec: I'll add a one-line policy note in the memo: when vendor credits previously reduced a liability and are subsequently reversed, we reinstate the liability unless revenue had been recognized tied to the credit.

vendor-relations-bot: CloudRack AM replied: "We're investigating; reversal appears to be a settlement adjustment not a system error. Will confirm within 48 hours."

mike.finance: Thanks — I'll prepare the memo but wait for confirmation before posting the GL. If they confirm final, we'll book the reinstatement as proposed. If they say it's tentative, we'll disclose in the close notes and consider a temporary clearing if necessary.

jordan.accounting: Agreed. Please include ERP screenshots and the original credit memo PDF in the close bucket. Close lock in ~90 minutes.

mike.finance: On it — uploading docs now. Will update when CloudRack confirms. :thumbsup:
